derivation: from H1 (אָב) and H410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God;
def: Abiel, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
